title: 応用プログラミング
subtitle: Computer Programming Advanced
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) acquire the basic ability to use IT for management. (2) learn computer programming using PHP. (3) acquire the ability to create dynamic web pages linked to a database.
advice: In the first half of the course, students will learn PHP programming with XAMPP, which is the operating environment of Apache (web-server), MySQL (database management system), and PHP. In the second half of the course, students will acquire the abilities required of a web engineer through the development of a web application combined with web pages and a database. ・For each lesson, students will need to bring a notebook PC. ・To prevent delays in completing the weekly exercises, students should consult with SA or senior SA during office hours if their program does not work.
requiredKnowledge: This course assumes that students have taken Web design, Computer Programming Basic, and Database Management. Students will need to review what they learned in these classes.
